company.name: MoPub
company.shortDescription: MoPub is a mobile monetization platform that helps publishers drive more revenue from advertising and mobile transactions.
company.description: MoPub, a division of the Twitter company, is rethinking mobile app monetization, enabling publishers to understand ad performance and user engagement. MoPub was founded in 2010 by ex-Google and ex-AdMob engineers and product managers.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for maximizing app real estate revenue by allowing multiple in-app bidders and networks to compete.
productsAndServices.name: Unified Auction

productsAndServices.description: Supports various in-app ad formats including native, interstitial, rewarded, playable, rich media, MREC, and banner display to enhance revenue opportunities.
productsAndServices.name: Ad Formats

productsAndServices.description: Enables reinvestment of ad revenues into user acquisition to drive app growth, utilizing AppLovin’s AppDiscovery engine.
productsAndServices.name: 360° Growth

productsAndServices.description: Provides a suite of tools for actionable insights on ad performance, revenue, and monetization strategy optimization through a comprehensive dashboard.
productsAndServices.name: Reporting Tools

productsAndServices.description: Facilitates testing of monetization strategies, including demand partners, ad configurations, and user segments, to identify revenue improvement opportunities.
productsAndServices.name: A/B Testing

productsAndServices.description: Automates the update of network CPMs and optimizes mediation for revenue enhancement without manual intervention.
productsAndServices.name: Mediation Management Tools
